blocks.heading: 📅 Dating Systems and Eras
blocks.intro: Different calendars and dating conventions have been used throughout Indian history to record time.

blocks.heading: 1. General Terminology
bullets: BC (Before Christ) / BCE (Before Common Era): Counted backward. Year 500 BCE is older than 300 BCE.
AD (Anno Domini) / CE (Common Era): Counted forward from the birth of Christ.
